input: 14 hand-built VCF records on chromosome 21 of the release-116 GRCh38 cache: an intergenic SNV, an intronic SNV of a non-coding transcript, single-base substitutions called stop_lost, missense (one with two alternate alleles) on a reverse-strand transcript and start_lost, missense, synonymous (one lower-case), stop_gained on a forward-strand one, a two-base substitution, a start_lost SNV the score file leaves out, a deletion and an insertion
generator: data/BayesDel_170824_addAF_all_scores_synthetic.txt.gz: scripts/fixtures/plugin_score_fixtures.py from variants.vcf, the layout the plugin's documentation prepares (BayesDel.pm:53-62 and 64-65), in the fixture a `#` header line and the columns `chr pos ref alt score`, with fabricated scores, one row per alternate base at every single-base site (the row the plugin must pick beside two it must not), plus one row per insertion, deletion and two-base substitution allele in the representation the plugin compares, no row at the unscored site, bgzip and tabix -s 1 -b 2 -e 2 (seed and digests under plugin_fixtures); the file's name is the name the plugin's documentation gives (BayesDel.pm:31), with the word `synthetic` added before the extension to say that the file is made up; json_cache: scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 over the chromosome 21 slice tools/vep-storable-to-json converts from the Ensembl VEP 116 GRCh38 cache; expected outputs: scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus for the manifest's run, and one Ensembl VEP 116.3 container run per format for each flag set from the vep command recorded under its flag_sets entry, the corpus mounted read-only at /work/corpus and the BayesDel plugin read from the container's plugin directory; manifest: tools/vep-golden-corpus select --include for every record, flag-set, then classify for the manifest's run and each flag set against the committed tree's binary
